items.q: Which gas is the main greenhouse gas from burning fossil fuels?
items.qAf: Watter gas is die belangrikste kasgas uit die verbranding van fossielbrandstowwe?
items.explain: Burning coal, oil and gas releases carbon dioxide, which traps heat in the atmosphere.
items.explainAf: Die verbranding van steenkool, olie en gas stel koolstofdioksied vry, wat hitte in die atmosfeer vasvang.

items.q: How does the greenhouse effect keep Earth warm?
items.qAf: Hoe hou die kaseffek die aarde warm?
options: Greenhouse gases trap some of the heat radiated from Earth
It creates heat in the atmosphere from nothing
optionsAf: Kasgasse vang van die hitte wat van die aarde uitstraal
Dit skep hitte uit niks in die atmosfeer
items.explain: Greenhouse gases absorb infrared radiation from the surface and re-radiate some back down, keeping the planet warm.
items.explainAf: Kasgasse absorbeer infrarooi straling van die oppervlak en straal sommige terug af, en hou die planeet warm.

items.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: A normal warming with no human cause
Extra heat trapped because of added greenhouse gases from human activity
The effect of the ozone layer
optionsAf: Ekstra hitte wat vasgevang word weens bykomende kasgasse uit menslike aktiwiteit
items.explain: Human activity raises greenhouse gas levels, trapping more heat and causing global warming.
items.explainAf: Menslike aktiwiteit verhoog kasgasvlakke, vang meer hitte vas en veroorsaak aardverwarming.

items.q: Which human activity increases carbon dioxide in the atmosphere the most?
items.qAf: Watter menslike aktiwiteit verhoog die meeste koolstofdioksied in die atmosfeer?
items.explain: Burning fossil fuels for energy and transport is the largest source of human carbon dioxide emissions.
items.explainAf: Die verbranding van fossielbrandstowwe vir energie en vervoer is die grootste bron van menslike koolstofdioksiedvrystellings.

items.q: Which is a likely effect of global warming?
items.qAf: Watter is ’n waarskynlike gevolg van aardverwarming?
options: Rising sea levels as ice melts
items.explain: Melting ice and expanding warm water both raise sea levels.
items.explainAf: Smeltende ys en uitsettende warm water verhoog albei seevlakke.

items.q: Which action would most reduce a person’s carbon footprint?
items.qAf: Watter handeling sal ’n mens se koolstofvoetspoor die meeste verminder?
options: Using a car for every short trip
Using public transport or walking, and saving electricity
optionsAf: Om vir elke kort reis ’n motor te gebruik
Om openbare vervoer te gebruik of te stap, en elektrisiteit te bespaar
items.explain: Reducing fuel and electricity use lowers the carbon dioxide produced.
items.explainAf: Vermindering van brandstof- en elektrisiteitsgebruik verlaag die koolstofdioksied wat geproduseer word.

items.q: The trapping of heat in the atmosphere by certain gases.
items.qAf: Die vasvang van hitte in die atmosfeer deur sekere gasse.

items.q: The rise in the average temperature of the Earth.
items.qAf: Die styging in die gemiddelde temperatuur van die Aarde.

items.q: The cutting down of large areas of forest.
items.qAf: Die afkap van groot gebiede woud.

items.q: A greenhouse gas released by cattle and rubbish dumps.
items.qAf: ’n Kweekhuisgas wat deur beeste en vullishope vrygestel word.

items.text: Burning [[]] fuels such as coal and petrol releases carbon [[]].
items.textAf: Om [[]]brandstowwe soos steenkool en petrol te verbrand, stel koolstof[[]] vry.

items.text: Global warming causes ice caps to melt, which makes the [[]] level rise. It also causes more extreme [[]], such as droughts and floods.
items.textAf: Aardverwarming laat yskappe smelt, wat die [[]]vlak laat styg. Dit veroorsaak ook meer uiterste [[]], soos droogtes en oorstromings.

items.q: Without any greenhouse effect, the Earth would be too cold for most life.
items.qAf: Sonder enige kweekhuiseffek sou die Aarde te koud wees vir die meeste lewe.
items.explain: True. The natural greenhouse effect keeps the Earth about 33 °C warmer than it would otherwise be.
items.explainAf: Waar. Die natuurlike kweekhuiseffek hou die Aarde omtrent 33 °C warmer as wat dit andersins sou wees.

items.q: Planting trees helps to reduce the amount of carbon dioxide in the air.
items.qAf: Om bome te plant, help om die hoeveelheid koolstofdioksied in die lug te verminder.
items.explain: True. Trees take in carbon dioxide during photosynthesis.
items.explainAf: Waar. Bome neem koolstofdioksied tydens fotosintese op.

items.q: Climate and weather mean the same thing.
items.qAf: Klimaat en weer beteken dieselfde ding.
items.explain: False. Weather is the day-to-day conditions; climate is the average weather over many years.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Weer is die daaglikse toestande; klimaat is die gemiddelde weer oor baie jare.

items.q: Give TWO things a family can do to reduce its carbon footprint.
items.qAf: Gee TWEE dinge wat ’n gesin kan doen om sy koolstofvoetspoor te verminder.
points: Use less electricity (switch off appliances, use LED globes, solar power).
Walk, cycle or use public transport / lift clubs instead of driving alone / recycle / eat less meat.
pointsAf: Gebruik minder elektrisiteit (skakel toestelle af, gebruik LED-gloeilampe, sonkrag).
Loop, ry fiets of gebruik openbare vervoer / saamryklubs in plaas daarvan om alleen te ry / herwin / eet minder vleis.
